messages:
viv-liu: Quick sync: I'm iterating a battlecard + 10-min webinar that leans into 'failproof serving' vs cloud APIs and DIY infra. Need a single defensible latency stat, a TCO hook, and inbound routing tags.

priya-k: Uploaded initial copy: https://redwood.internal/mkt/bcards/failproof-v1. Main asks: be evidence-first, add a 1-line AE elevator, and a procurement line that buyers can reuse.

sam-g: Sales request: one p99 soundbite for enterprise calls (long convs). Can we credibly say something like "~3x lower p99 on long-form prompts"? Jon?

jon-eng: Short bench excerpt (different workload): warm cache, mixed convs, 25k requests.

jon-eng: ```
workload    | seq=1500 p50 | seq=1500 p99
Redwood-R1  | 52ms         | 680ms
VendorZ-Std | 120ms        | 2100ms
notes: batching=8, stable kernels, 25k samples
```

casey-sales: Nice. Procurement one-liner suggestion: "Managed serving + rollouts and audit logs reduces procurement risk vs buying raw GPUs." Also please add SDR inbound tags: onprem_request, sla_required, compliance_need.

meera-se: Webinar plan: 10m total: 1m elevator, 3m econ slide (batching+caching delta), 4m live demo (traffic + simulated AZ outage + fallback), 2m Q&A/CTA. Title idea: "Failproof LLM features: economics, failovers, and proofs." Keep it product-positive not competitor-shaming.

priya-k: I'll craft an AE elevator: "Redwood Inference keeps LLM features online with predictable unit cost and production-grade fallbacks — easiest way to move from prototype to SLA-backed inference." Thoughts?

sam-g: Good. Add a tiny TCO example: show ops hours saved + expected infra delta over 3 years. Casey can plug numbers.

jon-eng: Also adding a reproducibility snippet to the appendix so SEs can run the bench: `python bench/run.py --model redwood-r1 --seq 1500 --batch 8 --requests 25000 --seed 7`. Use cautious phrasing next to the stat.

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar tentative Thurs 11am PT. Book speakers by Tue EOD. :calendar:

viv-liu: Great thread. Next steps: Priya updates card + AE elevator; Jon inserts methodology + repro; Casey prepares TCO delta slide + inbound tags; Meera finalizes runbook. Target: push updated battlecard + slide deck Thu EOD. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
